About the Scholarship

Up to 15 fully funded PhD scholarships available in the Department of Chemical Engineering at Imperial College London.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: Chemical Engineering Departmental Scholarships
HostImperial College London
LocationLondon, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
Stipend£22,780 - £25,000 per year (tax-free)
Application DeadlineOpen - Apply as soon as possible
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Full Title: Department of Chemical Engineering PhD Scholarships
  • Host Institution: Imperial College London
  • Department: Department of Chemical Engineering
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Start Date: October 2026
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: £22,780 - £25,000 per year (tax-free)
  • Tuition Fees: Covered
  • Eligibility: 10 scholarships open to all; 5 reserved for Home students
  • Application Deadline: Please check individual project pages (likely ongoing)

Available Projects

  • Faraday Institution PhD Studentship: Sustainable and Scalable Sodium-Ion Cathodes for Future Energy Storage (Prof. Magda Titirici)
  • Engineering biology approaches to mammalian cells (Dr Francesca Ceroni)
  • Ionic Liquids for reprocessing of EV batteries and other waste streams (Prof. Paul Fennell)
  • Statistical mechanical modelling of thermophysical properties of complex fluids (Prof. George Jackson)
  • Data-driven modelling and prediction of complex systems (Prof. Serafim Kalliadasis)
  • General hydrodynamics of observables (Prof. Serafim Kalliadasis)
  • Application of CFD, Machine Learning, and Shape Optimization to flow chemistry (Prof. Omar Matar)
  • Design of sustainable fluids using machine learning and molecular simulation (Prof. Erich Muller)
  • Digital tools for sustainable process and supply chain (Dr Maria Papathanasiou)

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/chemical-engineering/courses/postgraduate/phd/scholarships/

Source: imperial.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Open - Apply as soon as possible - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About Imperial College London

Imperial College London is a public research university focused on science, engineering, medicine and business. Based in London, it offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in these fields. Its academic community combines scientific research with practical applications, working with healthcare, industry and international partners on technological and societal challenges worldwide.

Official website: https://www.imperial.ac.uk/

Check the departmental website for specific project application details.
